items.period: Shang oracle-script style; the modern file was uploaded in 2020
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern Inkscape vector redraw derived from Xiaoxuetang record 45.EC02, noted as 甲799 / 合34479
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of a Shang oracle-script form of 非, attributed by the file description to Xiaoxuetang record 45.EC02. The cited CUHK account interprets early forms as wings spread apart, but that interpretation is disputed; this drawing is not an artifact photograph.
items.alt: Black vector strokes representing 非 in an oracle-script style on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: A sourced candidate for illustrating the reported oracle-bone form. Its provenance page names a specific Xiaoxuetang record and corpus references; its modern redraw status and rights are explicit.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain, as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page; Xiaoxuetang's official notice also dedicates queried glyph images and attributes under CC0 1.0.

limitations.text: The proposed image was not visually inspected in this research stage. The SVG fetch was rejected by the browser for unsupported content type, and the exact linked Xiaoxuetang record page returned a cache miss. Its educational use should therefore be understood from the source-page description and provenance, not a visual check made here.

The oracle-bone interpretation as spread wings is an account recorded by CUHK and attributed there to Xu Shen and Lin Yiguang; it is not settled by the image candidate itself. Reported graph inventories and lexical examples do not, by themselves, establish a complete graphic or semantic chronology.
